name: Siegfried Kaslana
source: Siegfried Kaslana, a knight belonging to the Kaslana family of Schicksal, with the strength equal of S-class Valkyrie. He is the patriarch of the Kaslana family, Kiana Kaslana's father, and the husband of Cecilia Schariac.
